meta.what: Audit of the 129 rent-only listings of block.ke for the rental landing page (notes/03-data-audit.md is the readable version).

sources.pages: ref/pages-final/ID.html (100 listings) and ref/pages-stop/ID.html (the 29 in ref/dev29.txt), all classic pages

caveats: The pages were saved from the public site behind Cloudflare: e-mail addresses in descriptions read "[email protected]" and a Cloudflare e-mail script tag sits in 17 descriptions. Neither is in the database.
Custom fields (bke_rent_usd, bke_rent_usd_date, bke_dev_layout, property_label_before and the like) are not in the feed or the pages; what the page prints is used instead.
ref/pages-final/40248.html is cut off after the tour panel: its agent card and similar listings are missing; every other field of 40248 was read.

Kind (home/commercial) is decided by the title words first and the categories second, so that miscategorised listings are counted where a visitor would put them; kind_by_category_rule is what the category rule of dev-v1.9.1.php:11360 returns.

The "v1.9.1" columns come from a Python mirror of the readers in ref/dev-v1.9.1.php (notes/tools/rp_v191.py). The mirror was checked against the PHP functions themselves, copied verbatim and run with PHP 8.3.6 on the saved description of every listing (notes/tools/php_check/make_harness.py): sections, snapshot rows, blockke_dev_rent_info() and blockke_dev_rent_phrase() agree on all 129 listings. Custom fields were taken as empty and the input was the description as the classic page printed it.

sections.title: Availability & Terms
paragraphs: Phase 1 of The Link has been operational since Q3 2024 and is 95% leased, leaving limited availability. Phase 2 is due to be operational in H2 2026, with units available from Q3 2026 — making now the ideal time to register interest and secure preferred units and configurations.

Pricing and lease terms are available on application. Rents, service charges, lease length and fit-out arrangements are to be confirmed at point of enquiry — contact us and we will share the current availability schedule, floor plans and terms.

amenities.title: Facilities & Infrastructure
items: Truck-friendly access: 29-metre-wide internal roads for 40-ft truck turning and loading
Loading: Dedicated loading/offloading bay per unit, with automated roller shutters
Power: 800 KVA transformer, 21 KVA supply per standard unit, with a common backup generator of up to 500 KVA
Water: Underground water storage capacity of up to 130,000 litres
Offices & welfare: Integrated office space and ablution facilities within the units
Fire safety: Fire hose reels and extinguishers per unit
Lighting: Energy-efficient LED lighting with natural light harvesting (per development specification)
Security: Protected within Tatu City, which is served by the National Police Service Critical Infrastructure Protection Unit (CIPU)

location.title: Location Advantage
items: Central road access: Easy access to the Thika Superhighway and the Northern and Eastern Bypasses, linking the park to all parts of Kenya.
Airport proximity: Approximately 40 minutes from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport (JKIA).
Within Tatu City: A large, planned mixed-use special economic zone north of Nairobi, combining industrial, commercial and residential districts — so staff, suppliers and services are close at hand.

suits.title: Who This Development Suits Best
items: Third-party logistics (3PL), distribution and e-commerce fulfilment operators needing modern, truck-accessible space.
Light manufacturing and assembly businesses requiring heavy floor loads and reliable utilities.
Importers and distributors seeking a well-connected regional warehousing base.
Export-oriented and multinational operations that can benefit from SEZ tax incentives and guaranteed expatriate work permits.
Businesses expanding out of congested industrial areas who value planned infrastructure, security and one-stop regulatory support.
